# costgraph_integration_providers (Data Source)

Read the deployment's FOCUS billing-provider catalog, sorted by provider slug. Returns provider names, categories, and documentation links without credential values. Catalog entries do not imply that the Terraform provider can manage those integrations. The API returns the complete catalog without pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "costgraph_integration_providers" "available" {}

output "provider_names" {
  value = [for provider in data.costgraph_integration_providers.available.providers : provider.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable catalog identifier, focus-billing-providers.
- `providers` (Attributes List) FOCUS billing providers sorted by their canonical slug. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category reported by the provider catalog.
- `docs_url` (String) Provider integration documentation URL.
- `name` (String) Provider display name.
- `slug` (String) Canonical provider slug.
